_cover_mode: template = write <output>-Cover.docx and leave body page 1 blank; supplied = reviewer has a cover, body page 1 blank; blank = body page 1 blank only; none = no cover page, TOC is page 1
cover_subtitle: <Building / area as it reads on the cover, e.g. Building A>
client_display_name: <Client and project as it reads on the cover, e.g. Example Client Project>
ep_project_no: <EP project number; rendered on the cover only>
issuance_date: <YYYY-MM-DD; ASK the reviewer at intake, never infer>
inspector: <Name of the engineer who walked the site>
cover_title: <PlanGrid project name, internal; falls back as the client display name if that is blank>
_footer: The footer is derived: Engineering PLUS  •  <client_display_name> <cover_subtitle> Technology System Punch List  •  Page N of M. Set footer_text only to override it.
